snippet.title: Chromosome Evil Trilogy - Final Trailer
snippet.description:
Chromosome Evil trilogy is now complete.
A special bundle was created.
Steam link: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/69305/Chromosome_Evil_Trilogy/

Thank you to all who made this possible!

Also, thank you, K4N, for the awesome video editing!

We at 16 BIT NIGHTS salute you, Commander!
